list.text: Thunder Island\nA stormy island ruled by thunder and roaring skies.
The path ahead is restless and unforgiving.
Those who walk forward must remain standing even when the thunder strikes.
Are you ready to face the storm?

then.text: The storm does not reject you.\nYou may continue.
